meta.title: AI CRM: sales pipeline and forecast demo
meta.description: Interactive demo of a CRM for sales teams in Colombia, with sample data: drag-and-drop pipeline, explained lead scoring, forecast in Colombian pesos, follow-up sequences and email and WhatsApp drafts.

demoCrm.pageSubtitle: Sales pipeline, lead scoring, forecast in pesos and email and WhatsApp drafts for your sales team. Try it: create, move and close deals.
demoCrm.sampleBadgeHint: This is the CRM of a fictitious logistics company (Logística Quindara S.A.S.). Companies, people, tax IDs (NIT), emails, phone numbers and figures are made up. Data cut-off date: {date}.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything is calculated in your browser from the sample data: each lead's score, win probability, metrics, forecast and alerts. You can create, move, edit and delete deals, and your changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.simulated: WhatsApp and email sending, sequence steps and call analysis are simulated: no message is sent and nothing is recorded. Drafts come from templates and the score from rules; no AI model is called here.
howItWorks.project: In your project, scores and drafts are generated by an AI model trained on your sales history, and the CRM connects to your WhatsApp Business, email and phone system.

actions: Send the contract with a 30% down payment and the balance in 30 days
Confirm the date of the first route
Schedule the visit to the Barranquilla warehouse
transcript: Hi Laura, thanks for your time. Did you get a chance to review the national distribution proposal?
Yes, I reviewed it with my team. The scope works for us; our main concern is starting before the December season.
I understand. If we sign this month, we can have the first route running in three weeks.
That works. What about payment? A down payment and the rest in 30 days is easier for us.
We can do that: 30% down and the balance in 30 days.
Perfect. Send me the contract with those terms and I will pass it to legal. I also want to see the Barranquilla warehouse.
Done. I will send you the contract and we will schedule the warehouse visit.

actions: Send a temperature report from a sample route
transcript: Natalia, what did you think of the cold-chain transport proposal?
It looks fine, but we need to see how you log the temperature along the whole route.
Each vehicle records the temperature every five minutes and we send you the report for every delivery.
I would like to see a report from one route before deciding. And the price is above what we pay today.
I will share a sample report. About the price, how about a 30-day pilot so you can compare?
A pilot could work. I need to check with management.

actions: Adjust the proposal to two containers per month
transcript: Felipe, I am calling to see how you are doing with the cargo consolidation proposal.
Honestly, this quarter we do not have the budget for the full volume we quoted.
I understand. What volume could you move starting now?
About two containers a month. Also, another company offered us a lower price.
I will adjust the proposal to two containers and show you what each option includes.
Fine, but call me after October 13, once the harvest is over.
